text:
mira: quick RFC follow-up idea: propose a 'floating chunk lease' to decouple in-memory residency from shard ownership. sketching goals + constraints below, pls react. :thinking:

sam: sounds interesting. what's the concrete problem?

mira: two things: (1) long-lived ownership blocks eviction during slow warmups -> OOM risk; (2) progressive hotpatching requires multiple loaders to stream overlapping ranges safely. leases let eviction look at active readers instead of owner locks.

jonathan: compatibility with safetensors and mixed bundles is crucial. how are leases tied to model versions?

mira: lease binds to (bundle_id, version, chunk_id, nonce). chunk_id is logical (content-hash or chunk-index). leases are short-lived (e.g. 30s) and signed by registry authority. loader re-resolves manifest on VERSION mismatch.

kevin: eviction race: loader A reads 0-512KB, loader B reads 256-768KB, eviction wants overlap. policy?

mira: leases have levels: read, read-block, pin. eviction checks highest level across intersecting ranges. read blocks eviction for TTL; pin prevents eviction until explicit release.

sam: runtime overhead concerns 12. don't verify signatures per-token.

mira: validate token on acquire and cache verification per-loader. heartbeats are async at chunk boundaries. per-token path unchanged.

jonathan: multi-format bundles: manifest must map chunk_id -> format, offset, verifier. lease stays format-agnostic.

mira: exactly. no on-disk layout changes. manifest carries format-specific digest.

kevin: observability: we need metrics + alerts for churn/conflicts.

mira: add metrics: leases_acquired, leases_released, lease_conflicts, avg_lease_ttl, lease_renewals. devops-bot: can you add alert for lease_conflicts > 50/min per-bundle?

devops-bot: added rule to staging dashboard; will notify SRE when triggered.

sam: error codes? callers need deterministic fallback semantics.

mira: propose: LEASE_EXPIRED (refresh & retry), LEASE_DENIED (permission -> fail), LEASE_VERSION_MISMATCH (manifest changed -> resolve), LEASE_CONFLICT (retry/backoff).

jonathan: rollout plan? backward compatibility?

mira: behind feature flag. loaders optionally opt-in. start canary on low-traffic models for 2w. older loaders use shard-owner semantics.

kevin: token format? keep compact and verifiable offline.

mira: use compact ed25519-signed token (small JWT-like) including bundle_id/version/nonce/ttl. loader caches registry pubkey per-bundle.

sam: API sketch?

mira: brief snippet:
POST /v1/lease/acquire
body: { bundle_id: "model-abc:v1", chunk_id: "chunk-57", mode: "read-block", ttl_s: 30, requester: "loader-7" }
resp: { lease_token: "<signed>", expires_at: "1829999030", lease_level: "read-block" }

mira: will write a short follow-up doc + test plan and tag eng-platform + infra. thanks for the feedback! :rocket:
